title: Ring launches NFL Game Day Cam Cover for all 32 teams
summary: Ring's officially licensed NFL camera cover lets fans showcase team pride on their compatible indoor Ring cameras, just in time for the 2026-2027 NFL season.
body_markdown:
---


## Key takeaways


- Ring's


[NFL Game Day Cam Cover](https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0H5MQR69S?ignorePSLD=1&th=1) is available for all 32 teams ($24.99).


- The camera accessory snaps onto Ring indoor cameras with no tools required.


- Compatible with Ring Indoor Cam and Ring Pan-Tilt Indoor Cam.


---


Just in time for the


[NFL](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/tag/nfl) season, Ring is launching


[NFL Game Day Cam Cover](https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0H5MQR69S?ignorePSLD=1&th=1) , the company's officially licensed NFL camera cover accessory. Available for all 32 NFL teams, the helmet-shaped camera cover snaps onto compatible Ring indoor cameras and lets fans showcase their team pride at home—no tools required.


[Amazon’s custom AI-powered Prime Insights take fans inside the game](https://www.aboutamazon.com/stories/prime-video-ai-live-sports-viewers-tv)


Real-time analytics powered by custom Amazon AI models bring expert-level insights to Thursday Night Football, NASCAR, and NBA viewers.


NFL Game Day Cam Cover is available for preorder starting Wednesday, September 9, timed to the 2026-2027 NFL season kickoff, at a retail price of $24.99 on


[Amazon](https://www.amazon.com/stores/page/22CDF701-F0FC-4D29-A5B2-23A1DAA60F7F?ingress=0&visitId=ceba9bc6-b26e-4549-aeec-ec76875db75f) and Ring.


## What is the Ring NFL Game Day Cam Cover?


NFL Game Day Cam Cover is a camera accessory in the shape of a miniature NFL team helmet. It fits over


[compatible Ring indoor cameras](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/devices/best-ring-video-doorbell) without impacting video quality or field of view. Fans can choose from all 32 NFL team designs.


The accessory features a simple snap-on design, so households that support different teams can switch between teams—or update their setup for every game day.


## Which Ring cameras are compatible?


NFL Game Day Cam Cover works with two Ring indoor cameras:


- [Ring Indoor Cam](https://ring.com/products/mini-indoor-security-camera-plug-in/color/white/power/plug-in/multipack/1-pack)
- [Ring Pan-Tilt Indoor Cam](https://ring.com/products/pan-tilt-indoor-cam?srsltid=AfmBOooL1PfIKwjfPl5amztQIMvoVo1P87dpDOj3MlDmUu3zhFenNS0I)


The cover does not affect video performance, motion detection, or two-way audio. It's designed to fit securely without obstructing the lens or sensors.


## How much does it cost and where can I buy it?


NFL Game Day Cam Cover is priced at $24.99 per unit and is available for preorder on


[Amazon](https://www.amazon.com/stores/page/22CDF701-F0FC-4D29-A5B2-23A1DAA60F7F?ingress=0&visitId=ceba9bc6-b26e-4549-aeec-ec76875db75f) and


[Ring](https://ring.com/) (


[AFC team helmets](https://ring.com/products/nfl-game-day-cam-cover-afc)


and


[NFC team helmets](https://ring.com/products/nfl-game-day-cam-cover-nfc) ). All 32 NFL team designs are available for preorder at launch.


[Ring introduces TAKE, setting a new industry standard for default encryption and control](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/devices/ring-take-encryption)


TAKE (Throw Away the Key Encryption) will become the default encryption for all Ring customers worldwide when fully rolled out.


## Why Ring made an NFL camera accessory


Ring built NFL Game Day Cam Cover around the moments customers already share with their Ring—game-day gatherings, welcoming friends for watch parties, and celebrating big plays. The accessory gives fans a way to personalize their Ring cameras and bring a little more of their fandom into their smart-home setups.


NFL Game Day Cam Cover arrives just as


[Thursday Night Football](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/entertainment/thursday-night-football-schedule-prime-video) returns exclusively on Prime Video for the 2026 season. Gear up your Ring camera and your screen for game night.


Next, learn


[how to watch live sports](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/entertainment/live-sports-streaming-prime-video) like the NFL, on Prime Video.
